label: South Africa
acts: Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, 1996
record_note: baseline 2009-04-02 derived from the Department of Justice consolidation (text as at 7 May 2026) by undoing the 16th, 17th and 18th Amendment Acts; amendments in force up to 2026-10-28 checked against the acts, their commencement proclamations and that consolidation on the retrieval day

scope.when_absent: no scope note is recorded in this history; not a statement that a change reaches every case

default_reach.meaning: a statute is presumed not to operate retrospectively unless it says so expressly or by necessary implication; no one may be convicted for an act or omission that was not an offence when it was committed
default_reach.authority: common-law presumption against retrospectivity; Constitution of the Republic of South Africa, 1996, s. 35(3)(l)
